definitions.explanation: Movable items used in a home or office, such as tables, chairs, desks, shelves, and beds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{家具|かぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{家具|かぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I replaced all the furniture when I moved.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家具|かぐ}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}み→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{始|はじ}められる→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: This apartment comes furnished, so you can start living there right away.

notes:
{家具|かぐ} combines ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (house) and ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (tool, implement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家具|かぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy furniture)
- {家具|かぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to place furniture)
- {家具|かぐ}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ (furnished — of apartments or rooms)
- {家具|かぐ}{屋|や} (furniture store)
- {家具|かぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧ (to assemble furniture)

COUNTER:
Furniture is counted with ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (items) or ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ (pieces). Large furniture may use {台|だい}.
